Fast CUDA now reuses motion and upscaled endpoints only when explicit source IDs, complete frame views and streams agree. Recycled buffers without IDs are recalculated; reset/reconfigure discard cached identities. The temporary Fast handoff is checked and consumed on errors.

Targeted RTX4070Ti checks reproduced six stale-result/error-lifetime behaviors in the previous backend and found exact agreement with fresh calculations after correction. Valid Fast pairs, B→A promotion and Quality remained exact on the tested inputs. The Linux player produced 13 identical output hashes and timestamps with the final multi-SM binary. This is a fidelity fix; no FPS gain is claimed. Fast retains its existing visual tradeoffs.

See [the qualification report](https://github.com/Ta2b/mpv-AnimeJaNai-HDR/blob/release/docs/qualification/lot-09-fast-views-20261016.md) for scope and limits. Windows builds are compile/link checks, not GPU hardware qualification. Platform assets appear independently as their builds complete.
